transient_destination.attempt_counter: persisted saturating u32; never reset on restart
transient_destination.retry: persist a next retry timestamp after every failed attempt, including attempt 11 and later; retry the same immutable failed boundary
transient_destination.status: destination remains degraded while its failure is armed, including during retry wait
transient_destination.startup: legacy exhausted failures stay blocked until explicit operator re-arm

operator_rearm.target: one armed transient_destination failure linked to the selected destination
operator_rearm.authorization: local owner endpoint, dry-run then explicit confirmation with a fresh nonce
operator_rearm.effect: consume the confirmation nonce, keep the attempt and failed boundary, persist an immediate retry timestamp, and wake the destination worker
operator_rearm.stale_or_duplicate: reject stale identity; repeat of the same confirmed request in the current owner run returns its recorded result without a second mutation

evidence.previous_packets: historical failures remain immutable and do not prove v2 recovery
evidence.required: two exact-head 120-second Docker ClickHouse outage runs with active capture, bounded WAL, degraded status, catch-up and PostgreSQL oracle match
